in_latin.name: Nathien
in_latin.long_meaning: Nathien, nomine significat servus; Christianus, qui Dei servus est; servus Dei, qui in fide et amore Dei vivit. Nomen Nathien a Graeco origine, κόππε κηα κιλώερσ, a Hebraeo אעבל בל הליית עלרי. Nathien in Christi Ecclesia usu venit, ut nomen sanctum et reverendum.

in_english.name: Nathien
in_english.meaning: servant of God; Christian; servant of the Lord

In early Christian tradition, Nathien was used as a name for a servant or a follower of Christ. The name Nathien is a symbol of devotion, loyalty, and faithfulness to God. It represents one who serves the Lord with humility and dedication. In modern Christian cultures, Nathien is used as a given name, symbolizing a strong faith and commitment to one's spiritual journey.
